name: cline-copy-last
description: Cline plugin that adds a /copy-last slash command to copy the last Cline session message (assistant response, user prompt, or conversation pair) to your clipboard as markdown.
author: cline-copy-last contributors

scripts.test: node -e "const p=require('./index.js'); console.log('Plugin loaded:', p.name || p.default?.name || 'unknown'); process.exit(0)"
